name: revoke-while-sending
description: A hostile site is signed in to the person's account, and its authenticated calls to Swarm ID are answered. The account revokes it. Its session is cut off at once, over the account bus, so Swarm ID's authenticated calls are refused after the revoke, and after it reloads its restored session asks the account's published state, sees the revoke and stays refused. Expected: Swarm ID's authenticated calls are refused after the revoke, live and on reload.
